in_hebrew.name: Harrington
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Harrington הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old English ‘heorot tun’ meaning ‘hare’s town’ or ‘the settlement by the hare’. In mythology, hares were considered sacred animals, symbolizing fertility, rebirth, and transformation.

in_greek.name: Harrington
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Hare's town
in_greek.long_meaning: Harrington είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from Old English ‘heorot tun’ meaning ‘hare’s town’ or ‘the settlement by the hare’. In mythology, hares were considered sacred animals, symbolizing fertility, rebirth, and transformation.

in_latin.name: Harrington
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Hare's town
in_latin.long_meaning: Harrington est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from Old English ‘heorot tun’ meaning ‘hare’s town’ or ‘the settlement by the hare’. In mythology, hares were considered sacred animals, symbolizing fertility, rebirth, and transformation.
